assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Original hotel-management scene in the VERY SPECIFIC visual style of the 1993 LucasArts adventure game DAY OF THE TENTACLE, a hand-drawn adventure-game background, NOT modern SaaS illustration. Cartoon anatomy when people present: huge noses, narrow heads, tiny torsos, enormous shoes and awkward expressive poses. Detailed environmental storytelling. No glossy rounded vector icons, no clean isometric render, no smooth corporate Memphis illustration, no gradients, no pastel fantasy resort aesthetic. ONLY chromatic colors allowed are small accents of app cyan #2ABDFF, pink #FF37C7, mint #00C3A0, violet #8251FB. These are accents on small props, labels, piping, upholstery details, NOT dominant fills. All walls, floors, large furniture and buildings remain neutral white/light gray. Sky if visible almost white with a trace of natural pale cyan, NEVER pink or purple. Bright readable daytime, never dark; no yellow, tan, brown, orange. Landscape 1536x1024. No text, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. Wide exterior scene: a gloriously crooked eccentric white hotel, leaning tower, irregular tiny windows, trapezoid entrance, wonky roof perspective and crooked little chimney, occupies RIGHT 40% of composition. Winding pale gray path and small grotesquely funny travelers arriving with luggage along lower edge. A cyan trim, one pink luggage tag, one mint shrub, tiny violet awning stripe are the only pops of color. Left 55% and top of image mostly empty near-white sky, suitable for a website headline. Buildings are light and angular, no large colored areas. Looks like an actual DOTT adventure game location with wit and asymmetry.
